stem_book: Arrange the following values in ascending order (ω is a non-real cube root of unity): (I) (1 + ω)(1 + ω²)(1 + ω⁴)(1 + ω⁸) (II) (1 − ω + ω²)⁷ + (1 + ω − ω²)⁷ (III) (1 − ω)(1 − ω²)(1 − ω⁴)(1 − ω⁸) (IV) (1 − ω − ω²)(1 − ω² − ω⁴) (a) I, IV, III, II (b) I, II, III, IV (c) I, III, IV, II (d) IV, III, II, I
